text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned knee pain after increasing your physical activity; can you tell me exactly where the pain is located and how severe it is on a scale of 1 to 10?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient presents with knee pain that started yesterday and has been steadily worsening. She cites recent participation in volleyball involving repetitive pivoting and twisting movements as a possible cause. She was advised at her last physical exam that weight loss could be beneficial for her health.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Tear.

The history of recent repetitive pivoting and twisting during volleyball, combined with acute worsening pain, is highly suggestive of an ACL injury. Given your age and mechanism of injury, I need to confirm if you experienced a "popping" sound at the time of injury and if your knee has since swelled up.
